featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a lovely family-run restaurant. The food is simple and has that comforting homemade taste you don’t find everywhere.

We often order takeaway from here, and it’s always consistently good. You can really feel the care and warmth they put into both the food and service.

A great place if you’re looking for homely, satisfying meals!

featured_reviews.name: K. “ContentName” F.
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was introduced to this small, family-run Maharashtrian restaurant by a family member.  Seating is limited (2 tables, around 10 chairs). There is wash basin on site but no washroom.

The Baigan Bharta is their signature dish. Highly recommended. We tried a couple of their thaalis. Bhangda, Bombil, Chicken and Vegetarian.The highlight of the meal was the inclusion of kardi with all thalis, a unique touch that makes it worth it.

The portions are pretty good, making it easy to share a thali between two people (with a medium appetite).

UPDATE: The Gawar Bhaji was a gravy, which I didn't find appealing. I also found that it lacked  coconut. This dish didn't tick the box for me.

While the menu may seem limited to some, the quality of the food is exceptional. For dessert,  ice cream is available at MRP.

We visited this place twice so far.

featured_reviews.name: melissa dcunha
featured_reviews.review_text:
It's extremely concerning about the quality and authenticity of the food at this restaurant. I recently ordered the Chicken Tikka Biryani, which I had tried a few months ago and enjoyed, with actual chicken tikka pieces. However, my latest order was completely disappointing.

The pieces in my order were blackened, the texture was wrong, and when shredded, the inside appeared red. The taste was unlike chicken or mutton, and it seemed like some other kind of meat, though I am not certain. This raises serious doubts about what is being served as "chicken."

When I called the restaurant to raise this issue, the response was unprofessional and dismissive. A staff member claimed that the chicken turns black when fried and directed me to resolve it with the seller. Even after being escalated to a superior, the concern was treated casually, and the only resolution offered was a refund.

While I have received the refund, the bigger issue is the apparent low quality and questionable nature of the meat used. I strongly caution anyone ordering chicken dishes from this restaurant.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at New Chaya Lunch Home, and I must say, the experience was both delightful and satisfying. The restaurant offers a perfect blend of affordability and great taste, making it an ideal spot for both casual meals and family gatherings.

Starting with the "Chicken Biryani", the dish was fragrant and rich in flavor. The tender pieces of chicken were well-marinated and paired perfectly with the subtly spiced rice. It was neither too heavy nor too mild, striking the perfect balance.

The "Chicken Kala Masala" was another standout. The robust, maharashtrian gravy complemented the succulent chicken pieces, offering layers of deep flavors with every bite. If you're a fan of bold spices, this dish will not disappoint.

The "Chapatis "were soft and freshly made, ideal for mopping up the generous curries. Alongside, the "Chicken Tikka" was wonderfully grilled, with a smoky flavor and perfectly charred exterior that contrasted well with the tender, juicy meat inside.

I also tried the "Chicken Manchow Soup", which was comforting and flavorful, with the right amount of spice and crunch.

Overall, New Chaya Lunch Home provides an exceptional dining experience with its delicious, reasonably priced offerings. It's a must-visit for anyone in the area looking to enjoy homestyle Indian food.

featured_reviews.review_text: I love jagdamba chaat. This is the only one place where I can have trust that they are using good water for Pani puri because I never eat Pani puri except this place. Dahi Puri is mouth watering and only one plate is enough then you will be full. Quantity and quantity is best.. for dahi Puri they use best quality of dahi which is for Rs 65. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Bhowad
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am so glad that I am the first one to review this place. I have been visiting this eatery God knows since when..I think from the year they opened I guess. 10 Years safely. Back then, they were famous for their Toast Sandwich. I am not exaggerating when I say- You won't get crispier, tastier and filling sandwich like this. They give green chutney and light Ketchup as accompaniments. Frankly, I am yet to come across better Toast Sandwich than this.

Years have passed on. They have expanded their menu with exclusive items like Chocolate Sandwich (I will never know what it is as I shudder at the very thought of it), prices have increased; but, their Toast Sandwich, chutneys have still retained the same taste and crunchiness even after so many years. Now, their Paani Puri is also one of my favorites. My brother likes their pomengranate topped Sev Puri as well. Every time I go home, we pick a day and munch here.

I heard that they have opened a new branch as well. I am very happy to hear that. Please keep up what you are doing.

featured_reviews.name: Donald Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text:
What's Good?
1. The staff is very responsive. The air curtain device was making a lot of noise and one of the staff overheard me talking about it and she quickly turned it off.
2. Tables and seating were clean.
3. The pizza was served in a pan and garlic bread in a plate.
4. There's an option of 'masala' softdrink.

What's Bad?
1. The glass door didn't shut completely, leaving a small gap through which flies entered in the outlet (it's monsoon season).
2. We had ordered by garlic bread with cheese. But it lacked the garlic flavour (although it had bits on garlic on it)

Pizza was okay.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Donald Gonsalves,We are sorry you had to face that! Kindly help us with your Order ID, email ID, and phone number along with the concern on hutcares@yum.com so that we may assist you better.   -Team Pizza Hut

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text: This Pizza Hut establishment boasts a standard menu with an appealing interior. The staff is notably friendly, offering helpful suggestions for pizza combinations. Regrettably, Pepsi Black was unavailable during our visit; however, this did not detract from the enjoyment of the delicious pizzas. It is a pleasant spot for evening gatherings, with ample parking available. Please note that mornings and afternoons tend to be busy, primarily with nearby students.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Ranajit Das,Thank you so much! Glad you loved the food. We hope you’ll order again, soon!     -- Team Pizza Hut

featured_reviews.name: Khaunpeeyunmast
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently tried the chicken wraps from Da Caar Wraps, and they were absolutely delicious! The chicken was well-seasoned, juicy, and paired perfectly with fresh, crisp veggies. The portion size is generous, making it a satisfying meal. What stood out to me the most was the hygiene — everything felt super clean and freshly prepared. The wrap itself was soft and easy to eat, but still held everything together without making a mess. Overall, if you're looking for a tasty, clean, and convenient meal, their chicken wraps are definitely worth trying!

featured_reviews.name: Dhwani Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text: If you’re craving rolls or wraps, this place is a must-try for healthy options. They use whole wheat rotis and offer a wide variety in veg, chicken, and prawn wraps. Veg choices include falafel, paneer, potato, and mushroom, with each dish having a unique name. The menu also mentions the ingredients clearly, making it easy to understand. The wraps have a perfect balance of flavors, with fillings prepared in different spices. Fried noodles and sauces are added, making them even more flavorful. Portions are generous, and at just ₹110. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Rishabh Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: They clearly do not value their customer's health or time. I ordered wraps through Swiggy, and the delivery was delayed by over an hour because they prioritized local walk-in customers instead of online orders. After such a long wait, the food was a complete disappointment, the roti was undercooked, I could literally taste raw atta, and the filling was unbearably spicy, making it inedible. It was so bad that I had to throw the food away without eating. Extremely poor experience.
